_note: Generated from opendpd.schemas.examples; do not edit by hand.

data.description: Data-aided RMS EVM and adjacent-channel leakage ratio of a capture bound to the ofdm-lte20-v1 reference waveform (LTE 20 MHz numerology, known 64QAM symbols). Not a conformance measurement.

metrics.aggregation: pooled over every complete OFDM symbol in the capture
metrics.formula: 100 * sqrt( sum|S_eq - S_ref|^2 / sum|S_ref|^2 ) over occupied subcarriers and complete symbols
metrics.name: EVM_RMS
metrics.notes: Data-aided (known symbols); single FFT timing position; see the protocol for deviations from TS 36.104 Annex E.

metrics.aggregation: pooled PSD over the valid range
metrics.formula: 10 * log10( P[-29, -11 MHz] / P[-9, +9 MHz] ) from the Welch PSD at the capture rate
metrics.name: ACLR_L
metrics.notes: Leakage convention: adjacent over main, negative dBc; the positive suppression convention equals -ACLR_L and is not reported.

metrics.aggregation: pooled PSD over the valid range
metrics.formula: 10 * log10( P[+11, +29 MHz] / P[-9, +9 MHz] ) from the Welch PSD at the capture rate
metrics.name: ACLR_R
metrics.notes: Leakage convention: adjacent over main, negative dBc; the positive suppression convention equals -ACLR_R and is not reported.

parameters.aclr: Welch PSD (Hann, dataset nperseg, 50 % overlap) at the capture rate; main channel [-9, +9] MHz, first adjacent channels centred at +/-20 MHz with an 18 MHz rectangular measurement bandwidth; 10*log10(P_adjacent / P_main), leakage convention (negative dBc, lower is better); requires fs >= 58 MS/s (3GPP TS 36.104 §6.6.2 definition; version fixed at cross-validation)
parameters.aggregation: EVM: pooled over every occupied subcarrier of every complete OFDM symbol in the valid range; ACLR: pooled Welch PSD over the valid range
parameters.applicability: only datasets bound to the waveform (signal.waveform); other inputs are missing_reference / not_applicable, never re-scored under another definition
parameters.equalizer: one least-squares complex gain per subcarrier over all complete symbols in the capture (data aided); bias factor sqrt(1 - 1/L) on noise-like error with L symbols
parameters.evm: RMS over every occupied subcarrier of every complete symbol at the nominal FFT position (end of the cyclic prefix); percent of the reference symbol power; also 20*log10 in dB
parameters.floors: EVM < 1e-9 % without rate conversion, 0.037 % after conversion from 122.88 or 800 MS/s
parameters.frequency_offset: coarse from the cyclic-prefix correlation (first 32 prefix samples skipped), fine from the slope of the per-symbol residual phase of the known symbols; no per-symbol phase tracking
parameters.normalization: none for ACLR (a ratio of the same signal); the data-aided equaliser normalises each subcarrier's complex gain, so the absolute scale of the evaluated signal does not enter the EVM
parameters.rate_conversion: polyphase resampling to 30.72 MS/s with the exact rational ratio (denominator <= 10000); capture rates below 30.72 MS/s are not applicable
parameters.timing: circular cross-correlation with the regenerated waveform; integer offset; normalised peak >= 0.3 required
parameters.waveform: ofdm-lte20-v1: CP-OFDM, 15 kHz spacing, 2048-point FFT at 30.72 MS/s, normal cyclic prefix, 1200 occupied subcarriers, 64QAM with known symbols (3GPP TS 36.211 §6.12 numerology; version fixed at cross-validation)
